candidates.title: PBench: A Physical AI Benchmark for World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Open benchmark with 1,044 cases, 5,636 QA pairs, code/data and physical-domain breakdowns.

candidates.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
candidates.why_candidate: CVPR paper and released system for user-steered connected 3D world expansion under ten seconds per scene.

candidates.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
candidates.why_candidate: Hybrid physics/video simulator covers rigid, elastic, cloth, smoke, liquid and granular dynamics.

candidates.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
candidates.why_candidate: Open 14B action-controllable robot video model with physics-aware DPO and EZS-Bench.

candidates.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Explicit cross-view communication and geometric priors for multi-camera robot world modeling.

candidates.title: PAI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark For Physical AI
candidates.why_candidate: CVPR 2026 Oral benchmark spanning generation, conditional generation and understanding with public datasets.

candidates.title: PhysBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Physical World Understanding
candidates.why_candidate: ICLR benchmark with 10,002 multimodal questions and evaluation of 75 VLMs.

candidates.title: Gemini Robotics 2
candidates.why_candidate: Official release demonstrates whole-body control, dexterity and multi-robot collaboration but lacks paper-grade technical detail.

candidates.title: Infinigen 2.0 preview
candidates.why_candidate: Material code release and performance update, but no distinct new paper.
